# fix and filter files

the trust4 output has counts under consensus_counts but immunearch needs it to be under duplicate_counts so i just rename. I also filter out any non-productive sequences

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Set your folder path
folder_path <- "Trust4/Airr_results"

# List all files ending in _airr.tsv
files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "_airr\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Loop through each file
for (file in files) {
  # Read the file
  df <- read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Filter rows where productive == TRUE
  if ("productive" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df[df$productive == T, ]
  }
  
  # Rename the column if it exists
  if ("consensus_count" %in% names(df)) {
    names(df)[names(df) == "consensus_count"] <- "duplicate_count"
  }
  
  # Overwrite the original file
  write.table(df, file = file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}

```

they have a purr issue I need to fix for this version of R. Also this seemed to require using fixed_threshold so I adjusted that as well

```{r}
seqCluster <- function(.data, .dist, .perc_similarity, .nt_similarity, .fixed_threshold) {
  if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'igraph' is required for this function. Please install it first via install.packages() or devtools::install_github().", call. = FALSE)
  }

  grouping_cols <- attr(.dist, "group_by")
  matching_col <- attr(.dist, "col")
  trimmed <- attr(.dist, "trimmed")
  if (length(.data) != length(.dist)) {
    stop(".data and .dist lengths do not match!")
  }
  if (all(!(names(.data) %in% names(.dist)))) {
    stop(".data and .dist names do not match!")
  } else {
    .dist <- .dist[order(match(names(.dist), names(.data)))] # This one cause removing of all attributes except names!
  }
  if (!(matching_col %in% colnames(.data[[1]]))) {
    stop("There is no ", matching_col, " in .data!")
  }
  thresh_cond <- c(missing(.perc_similarity), missing(.nt_similarity), missing(.fixed_threshold))
  if (all(thresh_cond)) {
    stop("Please, provide .perc_similarity, .nt_similarity or .fixed_threshold value")
  }
  if (sum(!thresh_cond) > 1) {
    stop("Please, provide only one argument: .perc_similarity, .nt_similarity or .fixed_threshold value")
  }


  perc_similarity_fun <- function(x, t = .perc_similarity) {
    x * (1 - t)
  }


  if (!missing(.perc_similarity)) {
    .threshold_fun <- perc_similarity_fun
  }

  
  graph_clustering <- function(dist_list, threshold_fun) {
    seq_labels <- map(dist_list, ~ attr(.x, "Labels"))
    singleseq_flag <- map_lgl(seq_labels, ~ length(.x) == 1)
    seq_length <- map(seq_labels, ~ nchar(.x))
    threshold <- map(seq_length, ~ .x %>% threshold_fun())
    group_values <- map_dfr(dist_list, ~ attr(.x, "group_values"))
    if (all(is.na(grouping_cols))) {
      protocluster_names <- purrr::map_chr(seq_labels, 1)
      result_single <- data.frame(
        Sequence = unlist(seq_labels[singleseq_flag]),
        Cluster = paste0(
          protocluster_names[singleseq_flag],
          "_length_",
          seq_length[singleseq_flag],
          "_cluster_1"
        )
      )
    } else {
      protocluster_names <- group_values %>%
        unite(col = grouping_cols, sep = "/") %>%
        pull(grouping_cols)
      result_single <- data.frame(
        Sequence = unlist(seq_labels[singleseq_flag]),
        Cluster = paste0(
          protocluster_names[singleseq_flag],
          "_length_",
          seq_length[singleseq_flag]
        )
      ) %>% cbind(group_values[singleseq_flag, ])
    }
    # ^if no grouping variables in data, sequences are IDs for clusters
    multiseq_dist <- dist_list[!singleseq_flag]
    mat_dist <- map2(multiseq_dist, threshold[!singleseq_flag], ~ as.matrix(.x) %>%
      apply(., 1, function(x, t) {
        ifelse(x > t, NA, x)
      }, .y))
    seq_clusters <- map(mat_dist, ~ reshape2::melt(.x, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
      igraph::graph_from_data_frame() %>%
      igraph::clusters() %>%
      .$membership %>%
      reshape2::melt() %>%
      suppressWarnings())
    result_multi <- seq_clusters %>%
      map2(., seq_length[!singleseq_flag], ~ .x %>%
        mutate(
          length_value = map_chr(.y, ~ ifelse(all(.x == .x[1]),
            yes = as.character(.x[1]),
            no = glue("range_{min(.x)}:{max(.x)}")
          ))
        )) %>%
      map2(., protocluster_names[!singleseq_flag], ~ rownames_to_column(.x, var = "Sequence") %>%
        group_by(value, length_value) %>%
        mutate(Cluster = paste0(.y, "_length_", length_value, "_cluster_", cur_group_id())) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        select(Sequence, Cluster))
    if (!all(is.na(grouping_cols))) {
      result_multi %<>% map2_df(., pmap(group_values, data.frame)[!singleseq_flag], ~ cbind(.x, .y))
      res <- rbind(result_single, result_multi)
      res[grouping_cols] <- str_split(
        str_split(res[["Cluster"]],
          pattern = "_", simplify = TRUE
        )[, 1],
        pattern = "/", simplify = TRUE
      )[, seq_along(grouping_cols)]
    } else {
      result_multi %<>% map_df(., ~.x)
      res <- rbind(result_single, result_multi)
      colnames(res) <- c(matching_col, "Cluster")
    }
    colnames(res)[1] <- matching_col
    return(res)
  }
  clusters <- map(.dist, ~ graph_clustering(.x, threshold_fun = .threshold_fun))
  if (!all(map2_lgl(clusters, .data, ~ nrow(.x) == nrow(.y)))) {
    warning("Number of sequence provided in .data and .dist are not matching!")
  }
  # supress messages because join spams about joining by matching_col is done
  temp_data <- .data
  if (trimmed) {
    for (colname in grouping_cols) {
      temp_data <- add_column_with_first_gene(temp_data, colname)
    }
  }
  joined_data <- map2(temp_data, clusters, ~ left_join(.x, .y) %>% suppressMessages())
  clusters_cols <- map(joined_data, "Cluster")
  result_data <- map2(.data, clusters_cols, ~ cbind(.x, "Cluster" = .y))
  return(result_data)
}


add_column_with_first_gene <- function(.data, .original_colname, .target_colname = NA) {
  .data %<>% apply_to_sample_or_list(.validate = FALSE, .function = function(df) {
    if (validate_columns(df, .original_colname, .target_colname)) {
      if (is.na(.target_colname)) {
        .target_colname <- .original_colname
      }
      df[[.target_colname]] <- df[[.original_colname]] %>% sapply(function(genes_string) {
        # first gene is substring until first ',', '(' or '*'
        unlist(strsplit(genes_string, ",|\\(|\\*"))[1]
      })
    }
    return(df)
  })
  return(.data)
}

apply_to_sample_or_list <- function(.data, .function, .with_names = FALSE, .validate = TRUE, ...) {
  if (has_no_data(.data)) {
    stop("Expected non-empty data; found: ", .data)
  }
  if (inherits(.data, "list")) {
    if (.validate) {
      .validate_repertoires_data(.data)
    }
    if (.with_names) {
      .data %<>%
        imap(function(sample_data, sample_name) {
          sample_data %>%
            as_tibble() %>%
            .function(..., sample_name = sample_name)
        })
    } else {
      .data %<>%
        lapply(function(sample_data) {
          sample_data %>%
            as_tibble() %>%
            .function(...)
        })
    }
    return(.data)
  } else {
    .data %<>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      .function(...)
    return(.data)
  }
}

has_no_data <- function(.data) {
  any(sapply(list(NA, NULL, NaN), identical, .data)) | all(is.na(.data))
}

validate_columns <- function(.data, .original_colname, .target_colname = NA) {
  if (!(.original_colname %in% colnames(.data))) {
    stop(
      "Trying to get data from missing column ",
      .original_colname,
      ", available columns: ",
      colnames(.data)
    )
  }
  if (is.na(.target_colname)) {
    # skip target check if target column is not specified
    return(TRUE)
  } else {
    # FALSE return value means that the column was previously added and no need to add it again
    return(!(.target_colname %in% colnames(.data)))
  }
}
```

```{r}
bcr_data <- lapply(immdata$data[keep], function(x) {
  x %>%
      filter(
        grepl("^IGH", V.name) | 
        grepl("^IGH", D.name) | 
        grepl("^IGH", J.name)
      ) %>%
    mutate( 
      J.name = case_when(is.na(J.name) ~ "NA",
                         TRUE ~ J.name),
      V.name = case_when(is.na(V.name) ~ "NA",
                         TRUE ~ V.name),
      Proportion = Clones / sum(Clones)
    )
})
```

downsamples the repertoires to the number of clones (i.e., reads / UMIs) that the smallest repertoire has

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
downsampled_bcr <- repSample(bcr_igdata$data, .method = "downsample")
```


"CDR3 region is the most variable region in BCR and TCR. This region is commonly used for calculating the distance between sequences. a similar CDR3 region could potentially arise from different VDJ rearrangement events. When running the analysis, group the clonotypes with similar CDR3 sequences by V gene, J gene, and/or sequence length to maximize the probability that similar CDR3 sequences arise from the same event (for BCRs)"

"In mathematical terms, a clonotype is a vertex in graph. If two clonotypes have the same V and J genes and ‘CDR3.aa’. differs by less than a predefined threshold value, we draw an edge between the vertices. A cluster is a connected component — a set of clonotypes connected by edges."

```{r}
distBCR <- seqDist(bcr_igdata$data,.col = "CDR3.nt", .group_by = c('V.name', 'J.name'), .group_by_seqLength = T, .method = "hamming")


# Now try running your clustering again
clustBCR <- seqCluster(bcr_igdata$data, distBCR, .perc_similarity = 0.85)

bcr_igdata$data <- clustBCR

saveRDS(bcr_igdata,"~/bol_bulkRNAseq_long.rds")
```

```{r}
run_betaregression_simple <- function(df, celltype_col, design_formula) {

  #ensure relevant variables are factors

  df_colnames <- colnames(df)
  df_colnames <- setdiff(df_colnames, c("proportion","total_reads","total_isotype_size"))

  df[df_colnames]<- lapply(df[df_colnames],factor)

  #make sure stage is an ordered factor
  df$phenotype_sex = factor(df$phenotype_sex, 
                       levels =c(
       "F_AA_Pos" ,"F_AB1.B2_Pos","F_B1B1_Pos","F_B1B2.C.D_Pos",
       "M_AA_Pos", "M_AB1.B2_Pos",  "M_B1B1_Pos", "M_B1B2.C.D_Pos"  ) 
                    )
  
  df$phenotype = factor(df$phenotype, 
                       levels =c(
       "AA_Pos" ,"AB1.B2_Pos","B1B1_Pos","B1B2.C.D_Pos" ) 
                    )
  
  df$Sex = factor(df$Sex, 
                       levels =c(
       "F" ,"M")
                    )
  

  #pull out celltype names
  unique_iso_types <- unique(df[[celltype_col]])


  #create list to store model, predictions and coefficients
  combined_list <- list()
  model_list <- list()
  coef_output <- list()
  pred_output <- list()
  emma_pairs <- list()
  
  for (iso_type in unique_iso_types) {

    #subset datafram to this one cell type
    subset_df <- subset(df, df[[celltype_col]] ==iso_type)


    #transform data since can't have 0s or 1s
    n <- nrow(subset_df)
    subset_df$transformed_proportion <- (subset_df$proportion * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
    df[df[[celltype_col]] == iso_type, "transformed_proportion"] <- subset_df$transformed_proportion
    
    set.seed(12345)
    #run beta regression
    #model <- glmmTMB(as.formula(design_formula), family = beta_family(), data = subset_df)
    model <- betareg(as.formula(design_formula), , data = subset_df)
    
    #add model to list
    combined_list[[paste0(iso_type, "_model")]] <- model 
    model_list[[paste0(iso_type, "_model")]] <- model 
    
    #extract and save coefficients to list
    coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients$mean
    df_coef <- as.data.frame(coef_table)
    df_coef$Coefficient <- rownames(coef_table)
    rownames(df_coef) <- NULL
    
    df_coef <- df_coef %>% mutate(
      p_symbol = case_when(
        `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
        `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.01 ~ "**",
        `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
    
    df_coef$Iso_Type <- iso_type
    
    combined_list[[paste0(iso_type, "_coef")]] <- df_coef
    
    set.seed(12345)
    emm <- emmeans(model, ~ phenotype | Sex)
    pairwise <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
    pairwise_df <- as.data.frame(pairwise)
    pairwise_df$Iso_Type <- iso_type
    
    combined_list[[paste0(iso_type, "_pairwise")]] <-pairwise_df

    
    formula_vars <- all.vars(as.formula(design_formula))[-1]  # Remove dependent variable
    predictors <- subset_df[, formula_vars, drop = FALSE]  # Extract only predictor columns
    
    predictors_vars<-list()
    # Ensure factors are properly set
    for (col in colnames(predictors)) {
        predictors_vars[[col]] <- unique(subset_df[[col]])  # Keep unique numeric values
    }

    new_data <- expand.grid(predictors_vars)
    
    # Generate predictions
    new_data$predicted_proportion <- predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "response")
    new_data[[celltype_col]] <- iso_type
    combined_list[[paste0(iso_type, "_predictions")]] <- new_data
    
    
    
  }

  
  coef_output <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_list[grepl("_coef", names(combined_list))], function(x) x))
  pred_output <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_list[grepl("_predictions", names(combined_list))], function(x) x))
  
  pairwise_output <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_list[grepl("_pairwise", names(combined_list))], function(x) x))

  #adjust prediction dataframe to match the ggplot naming we've been using previously (ie from numeric to characters)
  pred_output <- pred_output %>%
    group_by(.data[[celltype_col]]) %>%
    mutate(n = n()) %>%
    mutate(
      predicted_proportion_original = ((predicted_proportion * n) - 0.5) / (n - 1), #transform back
      predicted_percentage = predicted_proportion * 100,
      predicted_percentage_og = predicted_proportion_original * 100
    ) %>%
  drop_na() 
  
  coef_output <- coef_output %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(`Pr(>|z|)`, method = "BH"),
    FDR_symbol = case_when(
        FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
        FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ))
  
  
  pairwise_output <- pairwise_output %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.value,
    FDR_symbol = case_when(
        FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
        FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ))
  
  model_output <- combined_list
  
  
  return(list(
    updated_df = df,
    coefficients = coef_output,
    predictions = pred_output,
    pairwise = pairwise_output,
    models = model_list
  ))
}



run_betaregression_mixed <- function(df, celltype_col, design_formula) {

        FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
        FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ))
  
  
  pairwise_output <- pairwise_output %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.value,
    FDR_symbol = case_when(
        FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
        FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ))
  
  model_output <- combined_list
  
  
  return(list(
    updated_df = df,
    coefficients = coef_output,
    predictions = pred_output,
    pairwise = pairwise_output,
    models = model_list
  ))
}

```

# isotype usage

```{r}
assign_group <- function(isotype) {
  switched <- c("IGHA1","IGHA2","IGHG1","IGHG2","IGHG3","IGHG4")
  nonswitched <- c("IGHM","IGHD")
  
  case_when(
    isotype %in% switched ~ "Class-switched",
    isotype %in% nonswitched ~ "Non-class-switched",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

# 4. Function to process each CDR3 file

process_airr_folder <- function(airr_folder) {
  airr_files <- list.files(
    path = airr_folder, 
    pattern = "_airr.tsv$", 
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  airr_list <- list()

  for (file_path in airr_files) {
    sample_id <- sub(".tsv$", "", basename(file_path))

    airr <- readr::read_tsv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(productive == TRUE, locus == "IGH") %>%
      mutate(
        sequence_no_N = gsub("N", "", sequence),
        isotype = sub("\\*.*", "", c_call),
        isotype = case_when(is.na(isotype) | isotype == "IGHGP" ~ "undetermined",
                            isotype == "IGHG4A" ~ "IGHG4",
                            TRUE ~ isotype)
      )

    airr_list[[sample_id]] <- airr
  }

  airr_list
}
```

```{r}

annotate_bcr_clonotypes <- function(bcr_data, airr_list) {

  isotype_clone <- list()
  clones <- list()

  for (sample_id in names(bcr_data$data)) {

    clonotypes <- bcr_data$data[[sample_id]]
    airr_filtered  <- airr_list[[sample_id]]

    clonotypes_annotated <- clonotypes %>%
      inner_join(
        airr_filtered %>% select(sequence_no_N, v_call, v_identity, isotype),
        by = c("Sequence" = "sequence_no_N")
      )

    # isotype-level clone summaries
    isotype_clone[[sample_id]] <- clonotypes_annotated %>%
      group_by(Cluster, isotype) %>%
      summarise(
        merged_clone_size = n(),
        total_clone_size = sum(Clones, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(Sample = sample_id)

    # cluster-only summaries
    clones[[sample_id]] <- clonotypes_annotated %>%
      group_by(Cluster) %>%
      summarise(
        merged_clone_size = n(),
        total_clone_size = sum(Clones, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(Sample = sample_id)
  }
  


  list(
    isotype_clone = bind_rows(isotype_clone)%>%
  left_join(bcr_data$meta, by = "Sample"),
    clone_summary = bind_rows(clones)
  )
}


```

```{r, fig.height=8}
summarize_isotypes <- function(isotype_clone_df, meta) {

  # ---- Construct all sample/isotype combinations --------------------------
  all_combos <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    Sample = unique(isotype_clone_df$Sample),
    isotype = unique(isotype_clone_df$isotype)
  )

  # ---- Total reads per sample ---------------------------------------------
  total_reads <- isotype_clone_df %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    summarise(total_reads = sum(total_clone_size), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

  # ---- Number of clusters per sample ---------------------------------------
  clusters_per_sample <- isotype_clone_df %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    summarise(num_unique_clusters = n_distinct(Cluster), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

  # ---- Cluster-level isotype proportion ------------------------------------
  isotype_cluster_by_sample <- isotype_clone_df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Cluster, isotype) %>%
    summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Sample, isotype) %>%
    summarise(n_clusters = n_distinct(Cluster), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(all_combos, by = c("Sample", "isotype")) %>%
    tidyr::replace_na(list(n_clusters = 0)) %>%
    left_join(clusters_per_sample %>% select(Sample, num_unique_clusters), by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(proportion = n_clusters / num_unique_clusters) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")   # <-- metadata added here

  # ---- Read-level isotype proportion ---------------------------------------
  isotype_by_sample <- isotype_clone_df %>%
    group_by(Sample, isotype) %>%
    summarise(isotype_size = sum(total_clone_size), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(all_combos, by = c("Sample", "isotype")) %>%
    tidyr::replace_na(list(isotype_size = 0)) %>%
    left_join(total_reads %>% select(Sample, total_reads), by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(proportion = isotype_size / total_reads) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")   # <-- metadata added here

  list(
    isotype_cluster_by_sample = isotype_cluster_by_sample,
    isotype_by_sample = isotype_by_sample,
    clusters_per_sample = clusters_per_sample,
    total_reads = total_reads
  )
}


summarize_classswitch <- function(isotype_by_sample,
                                  isotype_cluster_by_sample,
                                  meta) {
  
  grouped_sample <- isotype_by_sample %>%
    mutate(isotype_group = assign_group(isotype)) %>%
    group_by(Sample, isotype_group) %>%
    summarise(
      total_isotype_size = sum(isotype_size, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_reads = dplyr::first(total_reads),
      proportion = total_isotype_size / total_reads,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")   # <-- metadata added here too
  
  list(
    classswitch_by_sample = grouped_sample
  )
}
```

# clonotype evaluation BCR

When .method is set to "volume" the repExplore calculates the number of unique clonotypes in the input data. i did this myself above

instead of having to rewrite every single code below to use the clusters, im going to modify the immdata files to be cluster based, rather than individual clone based

```{r}
clustered_bcr_igdata <- list()

for (i in seq_along(bcr_igdata$data)) {
  name <- names(bcr_igdata$data)[[i]]
  x <- bcr_igdata$data[[i]]
  
clustered_bcr_igdata[[name]] <- x %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Clones = sum(Clones),
    V.name = names(which.max(table(V.name))),
    J.name = names(which.max(table(J.name))),
    CDR3.nt = names(which.max(table(CDR3.nt))),
    CDR3.aa = names(which.max(table(CDR3.aa))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Clones / sum(Clones, na.rm = TRUE))
  
}

clustered_bcr_igdata <- list(data = clustered_bcr_igdata, meta = bcr_igdata$meta)

    CDR3.nt = names(which.max(table(CDR3.nt))),
    CDR3.aa = names(which.max(table(CDR3.nt))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Proportion = Clones / sum(Clones, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r, fig.height = 1.5, fig.width=2.15}
expanded_fraction_df <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(names(clustered_bcr_igdata$data), function(name) {
    
    df <- clustered_bcr_igdata$data[[name]]
    
    total_reads <- sum(df$Clones, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate clone frequencies
    df$freq <- df$Clones / total_reads
    
    expanded_fraction <- sum(df$freq[df$freq > 0.01], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    data.frame(
      Sample = name,
      expanded_fraction_1 = expanded_fraction,
      total_clones = total_reads
    )
  })
)


expanded_fraction_df <- merge(expanded_fraction_df, clustered_bcr_igdata$meta,by = "Sample")


    #transform data since can't have 0s or 1s

    expanded_fraction_df$transformed_proportion <- (expanded_fraction_df$expanded_fraction_1 * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

    
    set.seed(12345)
    #run beta regression. no covariates = + seqbatch. keep simpler model
   beta_0.01 <- betareg(transformed_proportion ~ phenotype*Sex , data = expanded_fraction_df)
```

```{r, fig.height = 1.65, fig.width=2.35}

down_expanded_fraction_df <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(names(down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data), function(name) {
    
    df <- down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data[[name]]
    
    total_reads <- sum(df$Clones, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate clone frequencies
    df$freq <- df$Clones / total_reads
    
    expanded_fraction <- sum(df$freq[df$freq > 0.01], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    data.frame(
      Sample = name,
      expanded_fraction_1 = expanded_fraction,
      total_clones = total_reads
    )
  })
)


down_expanded_fraction_df <- merge(down_expanded_fraction_df, down_clustered_bcr_igdata$meta,by = "Sample")


    #transform data since can't have 0s or 1s
    n <- nrow(down_expanded_fraction_df)
    down_expanded_fraction_df$transformed_proportion <- (down_expanded_fraction_df$expanded_fraction_1 * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

    
    set.seed(12345)
    #run beta regression AIC better with seqbatch = seqbatch + media, = none = media
   down_beta_0.01 <- betareg(transformed_proportion ~ phenotype*Sex , data = down_expanded_fraction_df)
    
    set.seed(12345)
    down_emm <- emmeans(down_beta_0.01, ~ phenotype | Sex)
    down_pairwise <- contrast(down_emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
    down_emm_pairwise_beta0.01 <- as.data.frame(down_pairwise)

    


down_expand_prop_sigs <- down_emm_pairwise_beta0.01 %>%
  filter(p.value <0.05)%>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(contrast, delim = " - ", names = c("group1", "group2"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
         FDR.round = round(p.value,3),
         FDR = case_when(FDR.round < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
                         TRUE ~ as.character(FDR.round)))%>%
 mutate(
    y.position = {
      mp <- unique(max(down_expanded_fraction_df$expanded_fraction_1))   # ensure it's length 1
      seq(mp * 1.05, mp * 1.2, length.out = n())
    }
  )

) +
```

```{r}
I'm taking for scRepertoire code below and modifying for my purposes 


clonalRarefactionDF <- function(sample_list, 
                                sample_col = "Sample",
                                clonotype_col = "CDR3.nt",
                                count_col = "Clones",
                                hill.numbers = 0,
                                n.boots = 20,
                                plot.type = 1,
                                end.point = NULL,
                                knots = knots,
                                palette = "inferno",
                                facet_by = NULL,   # new argument for grouping variable in meta
                                exportTable = FALSE) {
  
  # --- 1. Build list of abundance vectors ---
  mat.list <- lapply(sample_list$data, function(x) {
    setNames(x[[count_col]], x[[clonotype_col]])
  })
  
  # --- 2. Run iNEXT ---
  mat <- iNEXT(mat.list, q = hill.numbers,
               datatype = "abundance", nboot = n.boots, endpoint = end.point, knots = knots)

  # --- 3. Extract the data used by ggiNEXT ---
  df <- fortify(mat, type = 1)
  colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "Assemblage"] <- sample_col
    # merge metadata into BOTH curve df and observed df
  
if (!is.null(sample_list$meta)) {
  df <- merge(df, sample_list$meta, by = "Sample", all.x = TRUE)
}

  df.point <- df[df$Method == "Observed", ]
  df.line  <- df[df$Method != "Observed", ]

  df.line$Method <- factor(
    df.line$Method,
    c("Rarefaction", "Extrapolation")
  )
  
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, data = df.point) +
    geom_line(
    data = df.line[df.line$Method == "Rarefaction", ],
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Sample, linetype = Method),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # extrapolation lines with alpha 0.5
  geom_line(
    data = df.line[df.line$Method == "Extrapolation", ],
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Sample, linetype = Method),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.5
  )  +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = y.lwr, ymax = y.upr, fill = Sample, colour = NULL),
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of individuals",
    y = "Diversity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Diversity",
    color = sample_col,
    fill = sample_col
  )

  
  
  if (exportTable) {
    return(df)  # raw rarefaction/extrapolation data with metadata
  } else {
    return(p)   # plot
  }
}
```

```{r}
div_shannon <- repDiversity(clustered_bcr_igdata$data, "hill",.min.q=1, .max.q=1,.col = "nt+v+j")

div_shannon_meta <- merge(div_shannon, clustered_bcr_igdata$meta,  by = "Sample")
div_shannon_meta <- merge(div_shannon_meta,total_clones_per_sample, by = "Sample")


set.seed(12345)
lm_shannon<-lm(Value ~ phenotype*Sex + SeqBatch, data = div_shannon_meta)
set.seed(12345)
emm <- emmeans(lm_shannon, ~ phenotype | Sex)
pairwise <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
emm_pairwise_shannon <- as.data.frame(pairwise)


#pval is already adjusted
shannon_sig <- emm_pairwise_shannon %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(contrast, delim = " - ", names = c("group1", "group2"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(group1 = paste(Sex, group1, sep = "_"),
         group2 = paste(Sex, group2, sep = "_"),
         FDR = round(p.value,3))%>%
filter(FDR < 0.05)%>%
 group_by(Sex) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = seq(
      max(div_shannon_meta$Value, na.rm = TRUE) *1.10,
      max(div_shannon_meta$Value, na.rm = TRUE) *1.20,
      length.out = n()
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot(Value ~ total_clones, data = div_shannon_meta, xlim = c(0, 20000))

ggplot(div_shannon_meta, aes(x=phenotype_sex, y = Value, fill = phenotype_sex))+ 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) + 
  geom_jitter(width =0.1, height =0, size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = unique(down_sample_summaries$phenotype_sex),
                     values=phenocols_sex) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(shannon_sig, label = "FDR", size =1.75) +
  scale_color_manual(breaks = unique(down_sample_summaries$phenotype_sex),
                     values=phenocols_sex_dark) +
  labs(y = "exponential of Shannon's entropy",
       title = "Full sample",
       x = NULL)



ggsave("exp_shannon.pdf", height=1.7, width=2.04)
```

### downsampled

#### simpson

```{r, fig.height=2.2, fig.width=2.3}

total_clones_per_downsample <- data.frame(Sample = character(),
                                      total_clones = numeric(),
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


for(i in seq_along(down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data)) {
  name <- names(down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data)[[i]]
  df <- down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data[[i]]
  
  Bcell_depth <- sum(df$Clones, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Add a row to the data.frame
  total_clones_per_downsample <- rbind(total_clones_per_downsample,
                                   data.frame(Sample = name,
                                              total_clones = Bcell_depth))
}

div_inv.simpson_down <- repDiversity(down_clustered_bcr_igdata$data, "inv.simp",.col = "nt+v+j",.do.norm=TRUE)
div_inv.simpson_meta_down <- merge(div_inv.simpson_down, down_clustered_bcr_igdata$meta, by = "Sample")
div_inv.simpson_meta_down <- merge(div_inv.simpson_meta_down,total_clones_per_downsample, by = "Sample")





set.seed(12345)

#residuals are super not normal, have to square, but now AIC better with SeqBatch
#reflection and then logtransform
t_value = log10(max(div_inv.simpson_meta_down$Value + 1) - div_inv.simpson_meta_down$Value) 

lm_inv.simp_down<-lm(t_value ~ phenotype*Sex + SeqBatch, data = div_inv.simpson_meta_down)
set.seed(12345)

emm <- emmeans(lm_inv.simp_down, ~ phenotype | Sex)
pairwise <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
emm_pairwise_inv.simp_down <- as.data.frame(pairwise)

  
#pval is already adjusted
simpson_sig_down <- emm_pairwise_inv.simp_down  %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(contrast, delim = " - ", names = c("group1", "group2"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(group1 = paste(Sex, group1, sep = "_"),
         group2 = paste(Sex, group2, sep = "_"),
         FDR = round(p.value,3))%>%
filter(FDR < 0.050)%>%
 group_by(Sex) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = seq(
      max(div_inv.simpson_meta_down$Value, na.rm = TRUE) *1.10,
      max(div_inv.simpson_meta_down$Value, na.rm = TRUE) *1.20,
      length.out = n()
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(div_inv.simpson_meta_down, aes(x=phenotype_sex, y = Value, fill = phenotype_sex))+ 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) + 
  geom_jitter(width =0.1, height =0, size =0.5) +
  labs(y = "inverse Simpson index",
       title = "Downsampled",
       x = NULL)+
     scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  stat_pvalue_manual(simpson_sig_down, label = "FDR", size =1.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=phenocols_sex) +
  scale_color_manual(values=phenocols_sex_dark) + theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave("inv_simpson_down.pdf", height=1.7, width=1.95)
```
